title: Atomic Shared-Limit Reservation and Monotonic Delegation Attenuation

name.const: Atomic Shared-Limit Reservation and Monotonic Delegation Attenuation

description.const: System owners must enforce atomic shared-limit reservations across concurrent agents and attenuate delegated authority monotonically across agent hops so no sub-agent exceeds its parent mandate's scope or remaining budget.

limit-reservation-semantics.description: Mechanism preventing concurrent agents from double-spending a shared mandate limit.

delegation-attenuation-rule.description: Child agent authority must be a strict mathematical subset of parent scope and remaining budget.

max-delegation-depth.description: Maximum permitted multi-agent delegation hop depth.

cross-institution-verification.description: How receiving institutions verify delegated agent authority across organizational boundaries.
